status_reason: Forge V2 Institutional Pipeline (CERTIFIED): Trades=16, WinRate=50.0%, BaseNet=3.868%, StressNet=3.754%, WF=4/4, EarlyCuts=0, NearTPSaves=5, TPExpansions=0, MC95 DD=2.81%.

atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for GBPUSD (SWING_TRADING). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=2.657, trend_persistence=0.271, mean_reversion=0.729. Learned timeframe weights: W1 (w=+0.297), H4 (w=+0.297), H1 (w=+0.217). Ablation-retained features: ema_trend (w=+0.521), fvg_impulse (w=+0.258), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.164), pulse_social_sentiment (w=+0.057) (pruned/left out by ablation: bos_breakout, liquidity_sweep, rsi_momentum, sentinel_news_sentiment).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for GBPUSD (SWING_TRADING): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=2.657, mean-reversion=0.729). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to W1 (w=+0.297), H4 (w=+0.297), H1 (w=+0.217). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [ema_trend (w=+0.521), fvg_impulse (w=+0.258), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.164), pulse_social_sentiment (w=+0.057)] and pruned [bos_breakout, liquidity_sweep, rsi_momentum, sentinel_news_sentiment].

penalty_hierarchy.unnecessary_early_stop_counterfactual_pe: If trade stops out early (breakeven or early close) and post-exit price action reaches Major TP without hitting initial SL, charge forgone_tp_r penalty.

mtf_intelligence_and_sensitivity_report.design_rule_enforced: Contextual weighted agreement: trades are evaluated via learned timeframe weights and never rejected solely because all 7 timeframes do not point in the same direction.

data_synchronization_audit.candle_close_semantics: Higher-timeframe values become available only after bar_open + timeframe_duration <= trigger_close.
